LanguageData.CC_Settings_OutsiderTalk_Tip: With a colonist selected, right-click someone from outside the colony who isn't hostile (a visitor, a trader, a guest, someone of a camp, a messenger, an envoy, a lodger) for "Talk with...": chat, ask about their home, share a meal or a drink, give a gift, ask them to put in a good word at home or carry a letter, ask a small favour (a lesson, something brought next time), invite them to stay, get to know them over their visits or court them, talk faith. Each plays out on the map: the colonist walks over, both stop and talk, and what comes of it follows both their natures, how the two get on, and what their people think of the colony. Their notables remember it, and a stranger becomes a face the colony knows. Right-clicking a hostile stays the game's attack.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_OutsiderTalk: Right-click someone from outside the colony to talk, share a meal, give a gift, ask a favour.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_OutsiderSpar_Tip: Offer someone a friendly bout with fists. Both learn a little melee; bruises are likely, and now and then (4% to 8% a bout, more between fighting tempers) one blow goes in harder than meant and leaves a real injury. A bout is practice, so their people don't count its blows against the colony.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_OutsiderSpar: A friendly bout with fists: bruises likely, a real injury now and then.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_OutsiderProvoke_Tip: Hard words to someone from outside the colony: it sours them toward the colonist and the colony, their people remember the slight, and someone with a hot temper may answer with the game's own fistfight, which their people remember too. Needs the deeper game hooks, so the fight's blows aren't counted as the colony attacking a guest.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_OutsiderProvoke: Hard words: a slight remembered, and with a hot temper a fistfight.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_OutsiderDuels_Tip: Challenge someone of a people whose ways know the duel (tribes, medieval folk, an empire's nobility) to first blood or until one yields. Those nearby gather to watch, and it is a real fight with their own weapons that stops at the terms; deaths are rare, but the game's own fight decides. Winning gains honour with their people, losing costs a little. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_OutsiderDuels: A real fight by the terms, watched by both sides; honour won or lost.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_OutsiderChatter: Colonists talk with outsiders by themselves
LanguageData.CC_Settings_OutsiderChatter_Tip: A colonist and someone from outside the colony near each other, both free (idle, at leisure, eating at the same table, passing by), sometimes start a conversation by themselves: two to six lines in turn over their heads, about what is going on right now (their town and its people, wars and the world's events, the weather on the road, the colony's own news, what their people remember of the colony) and picking up what they talked about before. The sociable do it more, the shy less; never with danger about, never with someone leaving or busy, and paced with the colony's other talk so bubbles don't pile up. What is said is kept: news goes into the town's "Heard lately" on the region window's Neighbours page and on its map, and how the two get on moves a little. No message or letter.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_OutsiderChatter: Talks in bubbles about what's going on, now and then, without being told to.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_OutsiderChatterFrequency: How often they talk by themselves
LanguageData.CC_Settings_OutsiderChatterFrequency_Tip: How likely a colonist near an outsider is to start a talk by themselves. An outsider still talks this way at most once every 4 hours and 4 times a visit, and the same two once every 12 hours.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_OutsiderChatterFrequency: More or fewer talks started by the colonists themselves.
